scope: Existing native workflows and their explicitly selected HTTP profile. This does not remove broader anonymous-platform obligations or claim full qualification.

definition.name: anonymous.SigninRequest
definition.representation: Native opaque credential custody; automatic serialization denies. HTTP is a separate closed projection.

fields.Cookie: authentication.BearerCredential; original flow possession, never JSON
fields.Remember: session.RememberPolicy; resolved configuration matching original flow
fields.CallbackURL: string; exact selected callback or explicit empty callback
fields.Caller: authorization.DecisionContext; trusted service actor, policy and anonymous signin action
fields.Device: string; verified deployment-signed browser correlation, not authentication
fields.IdempotencyKey: identity.IdempotencyKey; required stable original scoped key

http.idempotency: Exactly one Idempotency-Key header; body/query forbidden

fields.Outcome: identity.CommitOutcome; distinguish committed, not_committed, unknown, conflict and in_progress
fields.Session: session.IssueResult; secret-bearing only on a fresh acknowledged commit
fields.Recovery: anonymous.SigninRecovery; original flow/actor/tenant/command metadata, not authority
fields.RetryAfter: time.Duration; positive only for in-progress work

http.fresh: signedIn:true, committed metadata, guest cookie and X-CSRF-Token; never verified-user authentication
http.historical: signedIn:false, replayed:true, original metadata only; no credential headers
http.failure: signedIn:false and redacted error; unknown remains unknown

definition.name: AnonymousSigninErrors

variants.unknown: identity.UnknownCommitError; reconcile original command, never regenerate
variants.unavailable: bounded infrastructure/cancellation or redacted native custody failure

definition.http: 400 malformed, 403 denial, 404 path, 405 method, 409 conflict/in-progress, 421 host, 429 rate, 503 unavailable/unknown; no secret diagnostics

definition.name: anonymous.DeletionRequest
definition.representation: Original guest credential and synchronizer custody; no caller-selected target or cleanup mode.

fields.Credential: session.Credential; actual original guest cookie/bearer; this HTTP profile is cookie-only
fields.ExpectedVersion: uint64; positive, non-overflow original lifecycle version
fields.Reason: string; registered policy code, 1..64 visible bytes

fields.Outcome: identity.CommitOutcome; protected transition durability, not completed retention job
fields.Replayed: bool; historical metadata, no active authority

http.known_success: deleted:true only for error-free known commit; clear exactly the guest cookie, including idempotent historical clearing
http.failure: deleted:false; retain original recovery/outcome without claiming rollback or clearing custody

definition.name: AnonymousDeletionErrors

variants.denied: identity.ForbiddenError; wrong possession, version, retention or legal hold
variants.unavailable: bounded infrastructure/cancellation or redacted native custody failure

definition.http: 400 malformed, 403 denial, 404 path, 405 method, 409 conflict/in-progress, 421 host, 429 rate, 503 unavailable/unknown

definition.name: anonymous.UpgradeRequest
definition.representation: Two distinct original possessions and the actual signed target proof. Structured fields/locators alone confer no authority.

fields.TargetSession: authentication.BearerCredential; original permanent session cookie in this HTTP profile
fields.TargetProof: authentication.ReauthenticationProof; genuine committed single-factor password proof, purpose identity.password.verify, action identity.anonymous.upgrade, exact configured audience/session/version
fields.Plan: anonymous.MergePlan; actual source metadata and authenticated target; no resource transfers; empty conflicts or sole display_name KeepTarget
fields.Remember: session.RememberPolicy; matches both original policies, no lifetime expansion
fields.Caller: authorization.DecisionContext; actual target actor, exact tenant/action/guest resource; ingress Time absent to preserve stable keyed intent
fields.IdempotencyKey: identity.IdempotencyKey; required original scoped key, not a replacement for one-use proof/capability

http.idempotency: Exactly one Idempotency-Key header; body/query forbidden
http.locators: native repositories load original proof and lifecycle; browser cannot supply proof authority or target ID

fields.Preparation: identity.RecoveryQuery; distinct original durable capability issuance command
fields.Session: session.IssueResult; newly committed permanent session preserves target authentication/remember, new ID/family

http.fresh: upgraded:true only for fresh error-free acknowledged commit; permanent cookie/X-CSRF-Token, clear guest cookie
http.historical: upgraded:false, replayed:true, both original correlations; no Set-Cookie or CSRF delivery
http.failure: upgraded:false, error and available original correlations; unknown is not rollback
http.atomicity: Original capability and target proof consumed once with guest disposal, all guest session/family revocation, permanent issuance and required risk/audit/outbox

definition.name: AnonymousUpgradeErrors

variants.unknown: identity.UnknownCommitError; original metadata-only recovery, no fresh mutation
variants.unavailable: bounded infrastructure/cancellation or redacted native custody failure

definition.http: 400 malformed, 403 known denial, 404 path, 405 method, 409 conflict/in-progress, 421 host, 429 rate, 503 unavailable/unknown; do not remap opaque unknown to known rollback
